runnethUseOptions.use_when_relevant: Use this whenever the user's request touches this area.
runnethUseOptions.only_when_asked: Use this only when the user asks about or reports this issue.
runnethUseOptions.status_page_only: Visible to CSMs, product, and operators, but not injected into Runneth by default.

notices.summary: Routine automation is temporarily paused during the refactor.
notices.impact: New scheduled, recurring, monitored, reminder, post-later, or background-upkeep work should not be presented as live reliable automation.
notices.workaround: Save the routine plan with cadence, trigger, task, workspace scope, and delivery target, then do the immediate one-time work where possible.
notices.statusPageGuidance: CSMs should treat new routine setup as paused. Save the routine plan and do immediate one-time work where possible.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to create, set up, schedule, monitor, remind, notify, post later, repeat, keep something updated, or run background upkeep.
notices.runnethGuidance: Lead with the constructive boundary, offer a future routine plan, and avoid saying anything is scheduled until creation actually succeeds.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture cadence, trigger, task, workspace scope, and delivery destination so the plan can be turned on later.

notices.summary: Older Slack installs may need reconnect to use the narrower permission scope.
notices.impact: Some workspaces connected Slack before Runneth's Slack app moved to the narrower permission scope. Those older installs may still show or retain the wider grant until Slack is removed and reconnected through Runneth; newly connected orgs already use the narrower scope.
notices.workaround: Use Runneth's own Slack removal and reconnect flow: ask Runneth to remove Slack, then start a new conversation and ask Runneth to connect Slack again. Do not uninstall the app directly from Slack.
notices.statusPageGuidance: Keep Slack as a standalone native OAuth card. This is permission/reconnect guidance for older installs, not a current outage for new Slack connections.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about Slack permissions, Slack security review, Slack reconnect, Slack reinstall, or replacing an older Slack install with the narrower scope.
notices.runnethGuidance: Explain that new Slack connections already use the narrower scope, while older workspaces may need a Runneth-managed reconnect to pick it up. Route through Runneth's integration removal and reconnect flow. Do not tell customers to uninstall directly from Slack, because that can leave the Runneth web setup widget or reinstall path unable to reconnect cleanly.
notices.supportGuidance: Confirm whether the org is a new install or an older Slack install. If it is older, tell the customer to remove and reconnect Slack through Runneth rather than uninstalling from Slack directly.

notices.summary: File uploads can fail or stall while upload infrastructure is rate-limited.
notices.impact: Slack messages with file or screenshot attachments may receive no reply, and starting a new chat with an attached file or screenshot can fail while the upload path is degraded.
notices.workaround: For now, start a new Slack conversation instead of continuing an existing thread. Start the chat first, then attach the file once the conversation is open. For anything urgent, paste the text or describe the file and try the upload again later.
notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Slack and Chat. This is not broad enough for a site-wide banner by default, but CSMs should know to start new Slack conversations for file-heavy workflows while the upload path is rate-limited.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to upload, attach, send, read, or analyze a file, screenshot, image, or document in Slack, reports that a Slack file-upload message got no reply, or reports that a new chat will not start when a file or screenshot is attached.
notices.runnethGuidance: Acknowledge that file-upload handling is degraded right now. If the user is in Slack, tell them to start a new Slack conversation instead of continuing the existing thread. Ask them to start the chat first, then attach the file once the conversation is open. For urgent work, ask them to paste the relevant text or describe the file and try the upload again later.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the surface, whether the upload was in Slack or web, whether the conversation was new or already open, the approximate time, file type, and whether the message received no reply, timed out, or failed before sending.

notices.summary: Pipedream integrations are available, but multiple connections per app are still limited.
notices.impact: Most Pipedream-backed apps are usable, but repeated connects to the same app can resolve back to the existing sandbox-level connection instead of creating a distinct account-specific connection.
notices.workaround: Use the existing connected account for now, or choose a native integration/API-key path when the workflow needs a different account.
notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Integrations as a limitation, not an outage. Do not present Pipedream-backed integrations as broadly broken.
notices.runnethTrigger: Do not inject by default. If the app later supports issue-specific hints, only consider surfacing this when the user explicitly asks for multiple accounts or multiple connections for the same Pipedream-backed app.
notices.runnethGuidance: Do not proactively mention this. If asked directly, clarify that multiple account selection for the same Pipedream-backed app is still being improved and suggest using the already connected account or a native/API-key path.
notices.supportGuidance: Check whether the request needs more than one account for the same Pipedream-backed app before treating this as a general integration outage.
